image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured pink surface. The bib features a white central panel with blue and white striped trim around the neck and edges. It has an embroidered design in the center depicting a tiered cake or stack of items. The neck closure appears to be a tie made of the same striped fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embroidered cake/stack design lacks clear thread definition; it appears slightly smudged or 'painted on' rather than having distinct raised stitching, which is a common AI artifact in rendering fine textile details.
The ties at the neck appear somewhat fused with the collar trim and lack clear separation or logical knotting structure; they blend into the background slightly unnaturally.
The stripes on the trim waver slightly inconsistently along the curves, suggesting minor geometric warping rather than precise fabric folding.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not a similar textile item like a placemat or doily.
To verify the physical continuity of the trim and ensure the ties are distinct entities attached to the main body, checking for fusion artifacts.
To analyze the realism of the embroidery stitches and the woven texture of the fabric, looking for smearing or unnatural patterns.

focus_areas: Integrity of the neck ties and their connection to the collar
Realism and clarity of the central embroidered graphic
Consistency of the woven fabric texture across the surface
Sharpness of the boundary between the striped trim and the white center
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'embroidered' design. AI often fails to render actual stitching, resulting in blurry patches that look like prints. Verify if the texture matches real thread work. Also, inspect the neck ties for logical physical attachment—are they separate pieces of fabric or do they melt into the collar?
